name: abstention_cases_v1
description: Out-of-domain questions for the seven languages (3 per language). The 02B corpus holds ONLY interview-preparation passages, so no passage answers these: a correct retrieval system must abstain (no citation). Used to calibrate the relevance floor and to measure abstention correctness.
independence: authored by engineering; synthetic; NOT native-reviewed; NOT an independent set. 21 questions are a planning-size sample only.
